title: LDDGO full-map remaining STRING/CHART/COORDINATE/IMAGE/FILE semantic review
method: Manual semantic comparison of saved official bilingual directory scopes against registered definitions, category arrays, reachable engine props, core functions and final lib/tool-copy.ts capability overlays. No new network requests or peer runtime operations. Specialist chart/geodesy scope remains needs-source where directory-only evidence cannot settle model/schema/conventions.

status_definitions.existing: The declared core workflow is reachable in one or more registered local tools, with no confirmed core gap from directory scope. This is not full feature or output equivalence.
status_definitions.partial: A reachable part of the declared workflow exists, with a concrete source-visible option/format/input/output gap.
status_definitions.missing: The requested workflow has no registered reachable implementation; near-name/dependency-only implementations are explicitly excluded.
status_definitions.not-comparable: External or non-tool target that should not be counted as a missing native comparable capability.
status_definitions.needs-source: Available evidence is insufficient to resolve a material workflow detail.

summary.validation: Exact 125-ID complement; unique IDs; every mapped/related slug belongs to a category array and ALL_TOOLS; every anchor line/excerpt verified against current source.
limits: existing means declared core workflow only, not complete feature/output parity.
partial can include a manual multi-tool chain; the boundary names missing direct I/O or controls.
needs-source does not imply an existing implementation; it preserves confirmed inventory absence while withholding an implementation-ready scientific/protocol specification.
No traffic, correctness, performance, accessibility, SEO or peer runtime quality inference.
All final toolCopy branches were inspected; data limits and format/animation caveats take precedence over older authored copy.

rows.next_action: Design and implement a registered workflow with independent behavior tests; adjacent tools do not close it.

peer_declared_scope.zh: 在线数据处理工具，支持打开文本文件和 Excel 表格，使用自定义 Javascript 处理数据，处理结果支持下载为文本文件和 Excel 表格文件。
peer_declared_scope.en: Online data processing tool that supports opening text files and Excel spreadsheets, using custom JavaScript to process data, and downloading processing results as text files and Excel spreadsheets.

rows.boundary_or_gap: CSV editor only transposes/swaps columns; spreadsheet converters export fixed CSV/XLSX directions. No user-defined JavaScript processing of text/workbook files with text/Excel output is reachable.
